scope: KTF retrospective on the difficult financing environment of the 1990s/2000s and constraints on international player development.
limitations: Retrospective qualitative evidence; the broad period is not an annual finance series and does not quantify participation or funding amounts.

observations.text_value: The KTF retrospective describes the 1990s and 2000s as a difficult period for tennis development because of insufficient financing and limited international tournament travel.
observations.source_locator: KTF federation explainer — development in the 1990s and 2000s
observations.definition_notes: Qualitative historical constraint evidence; does not provide annual funding totals or a complete system census.
